title: Anthropic takes 158,138 sq ft at 1 Triton Square, NW1
body: AI company Anthropic has let 158,138 sq ft at 1 Triton Square in King's Cross/Euston at a blended £97.50 per sq ft, one of the largest lettings of the quarter.

title: OpenAI signs for 89,975 sq ft at Jahn Court, N1
body: OpenAI has taken 89,975 sq ft at Jahn Court at a blended £97.00 per sq ft, adding to tech and AI occupier demand around King's Cross.

title: Barclays buys 1 Churchill Place, Canary Wharf, for £750m
body: Barclays has acquired its Canary Wharf headquarters at 1 Churchill Place for £750m, reflecting a 5.62% yield. The deal lifted Docklands & Stratford investment turnover to £0.75bn in Q2 2026.

title: Central London vacancy falls to 8.0% as active requirements reach 14.3m sq ft
body: London office vacancy fell to 8.0% in Q2 2026 while active requirements rose to 14.3m sq ft. Take-up rebounded to 3.1m sq ft after a subdued first quarter.

title: Investment sentiment hit by renewed interest rate volatility
body: London office investment edged up to £2.0bn in Q2 2026, but sentiment was affected by renewed interest rate volatility.

title: Herbert Smith Freehills commits to 266,054 sq ft at 1 Appold Street, EC2A
body: Law firm Herbert Smith Freehills has taken 266,054 sq ft at 1 Appold Street in the City at £103.00 per sq ft.

title: Databricks takes 137,311 sq ft at Network, Fitzrovia
body: Data and AI company Databricks has signed for 137,311 sq ft at Network, 10 Howland Street, W1T at £103.50 per sq ft.

title: London office investment slows in Q1 as rate volatility dents sentiment
body: Investment volumes fell to £1.9bn in Q1 2026. Interest rate volatility dented sentiment, though underlying appetite is not seen as weaker.

title: Bank of England holds Bank Rate at 3.75%
body: The Monetary Policy Committee held Bank Rate at 3.75% at its first meeting of 2026, with four of nine members voting for a quarter-point cut.

title: Visa takes 300,000 sq ft at 1 Canada Square, Canary Wharf
body: Visa has committed to 300,000 sq ft at 1 Canada Square, the largest letting in Canary Wharf this year.

title: Q4 2025 London office investment hits £3.3bn, best quarter since Q1 2022
body: London office investment reached £3.3bn in Q4 2025 with a further £3.1bn under offer, the strongest quarter since Q1 2022.

title: Ares Management pays £179.50 per sq ft at 1 Hanover Street, Mayfair
body: Ares Management has taken 123,968 sq ft at 1 Hanover Street in the West End Core at a blended £179.50 per sq ft, underlining record prime rents.

title: HSBC takes 170,894 sq ft at 40 Bank Street, E14
body: HSBC has let 170,894 sq ft at 40 Bank Street in Canary Wharf.

title: Space under offer rises to 3.3m sq ft as leasing softens
body: Leasing activity softened in Q3 2025, but space under offer rose to 3.3m sq ft and a constrained development pipeline continues to shape occupier decisions.

title: Record share of take-up in new and refurbished space
body: Almost three-quarters of London take-up in Q2 2025 was new or refurbished space, a record. Occupiers are prioritising high-quality sustainable workspace, a clear flight to quality.

title: City Core new-space vacancy drops to 0.5%
body: New-space vacancy in the City Core fell to 0.5%, and the West End is projected to be undersupplied by about 1.2m sq ft by the end of 2028.

title: Squarepoint pre-lets 398,227 sq ft at 65 Gresham Street
body: Squarepoint Capital has pre-let 398,227 sq ft at 65 Gresham Street, EC2, due to complete in Q2 2028.

title: Two speculative schemes under construction in Docklands
body: 17 Columbus Courtyard (178,338 sq ft, due Q4 2026) and One North Quay (540,000 sq ft, due by end 2027) are under construction speculatively in Docklands.

title: UK unemployment rate edges down to 4.9%
body: The UK unemployment rate was 4.9% in March to May 2026, edging down on the quarter but higher than a year earlier. Payrolled employees fell 85,000 year on year.
